Authorization: an access token from the tenant's issuer whose audience is this URL (RFC 8707), as Bearer or DPoP (required when the workspace says so). Without one: 401 with WWW-Authenticate Bearer resource_metadata=..., scope=...; a token for another resource: 401 error=invalid_token; no usable scope: 403 error=insufficient_scope. The query ?groups=workflows,agents,knowledge,tools,records narrows the tool groups.
